definition: used before an action you wish to do
sentence: I want to learn English.

definition: used before an action that is necessary
sentence: We need to leave now.

definition: used before an action you attempt
sentence: Try to open the door.

definition: used for an action required by a rule or situation
sentence: I have to go to work.

definition: used to express a wish or request politely
sentence: I would like some tea.

definition: have the ability to do something
sentence: He is able to swim.

definition: used for a plan or something expected to happen
sentence: We are going to visit Grandma.

definition: used for a past habit or state that has changed
sentence: I used to live here.

definition: allow a person to perform an action
sentence: Let the child play.

definition: request a person to perform an action
sentence: Ask him to close the door.

definition: instruct a person to perform an action
sentence: Tell him to wait here.

definition: assist a person in performing an action
sentence: Help me carry the box.

definition: gain the ability to perform an action
sentence: We learn to swim.
additionalExamples: She learns to swim with a teacher.

definition: understand the method for performing an action
sentence: I know how to open it.

definition: feel happy about something that will happen
sentence: I look forward to seeing you.
context: We look forward to going away.

definition: be going to do something very soon
sentence: I am about to leave.

definition: be ready to do something because you want to help or agree
sentence: I am willing to help.

definition: probably do or be something
sentence: The train is likely to be late.
context: The train is likely to be late.

definition: have permission to do something
sentence: We are allowed to park here.
context: We are allowed to park here.

definition: be expected or required to do something
sentence: We are supposed to meet at nine.
context: We are supposed to meet at nine.

definition: be familiar with something so that it feels normal
sentence: I am used to getting up early.
usage: be used to + noun or -ing; compare: used to + verb
context: I am used to getting up early.
It feels normal to me now.

definition: start communicating with someone
sentence: Please get in touch with me next week.
context: Please get in touch with me next week.

definition: think of an idea or solution
sentence: She came up with a good idea.
usage: come up with an idea or solution
context: She came up with a good idea.

definition: contact someone later with an answer or more information
sentence: I will get back to you tomorrow.
context: I will get back to you tomorrow.

definition: used to say what someone should do to avoid a problem
sentence: We had better leave now or we will be late.
context: We had better leave now or we will be late.
usage: had better + verb / had better not + verb
additionalExamples: You had better not lose that key.
